decisions.title: Composable Platform
decisions.decision: CFIP owns domain/contracts/governance; OSS supplies reusable capabilities behind adapters.

decisions.title: Modular Monolith First
decisions.decision: Start with explicit bounded contexts and extract services only with measurable justification.

decisions.title: NATS JetStream Baseline
decisions.decision: Use NATS JetStream as baseline event infrastructure; benchmark alternatives before any change.

decisions.title: Elyrava Framework Neutrality
decisions.decision: Elyrava exposes stable contracts and may adapt multiple agent/model frameworks.

decisions.title: Fork Last
decisions.decision: Prefer upstream, adapter, extension and upstream patch before fork or bespoke implementation.

decisions.title: OSS Popularity Is Not Evidence
decisions.decision: Popularity alone is never a runtime adoption criterion.

decisions.title: One Production Implementation Per Capability
decisions.decision: Avoid simultaneous competing runtime implementations unless a documented architectural reason exists.
